assignments.name: Jungle Fatigues
item_labels: Simple Olive Drab fatigues, offering the basic level of defense, main weapon storage, ammo storage, and camo index.

assignments.name: Naked
item_labels: Fatigues with low defense, camo index, and main weapon ammo storage, but high movement speed. Good for players who like raw, intense combat.

assignments.name: Naked
item_labels: Fatigues with low defense, camo index, and main weapon ammo storage, but high movement speed. Good for players who like raw, intense combat.

assignments.name: Amanda
item_labels: Same fatigues as Amanda. Identical in basic characteristics to Jungle Fatigues, but LIFE recovery and movement speed are slightly higher. For women only.

assignments.name: Rathalos
item_labels: Variation of Jungle Fatigues camouflage. Adds Rathalos's Bind Voice ability to CO-OPS messages. Battle Cry can then stop enemies from moving!

assignments.name: Gear REX
item_labels: Variation of Jungle Fatigues camouflage. Grants the wearer the ability to steal PSYCHE from enemies after grabbing them.

assignments.name: Tuxedo
item_labels: A tuxedo. Though not exactly suited for combat missions, you're sure to be the best-dressed. Very low camo index.

assignments.name: Naked (Leaf)
item_labels: Variation of Naked with camouflage pants. Raises camo index in jungle environments, but only half as much as full-body camo.

assignments.name: Naked (Tiger Stripe)
item_labels: Variation of Naked with camouflage pants. Raises camo index near water, but only half as much as full-body camo.

assignments.name: Naked (Choco Chip)
item_labels: Variation of Naked with camouflage pants. Raises camo index in dirt or sand environments, but only half as much as full-body camo.
